answer: Each agent seals every graded answer into a sparrow transcript, hashed with a fresh nonce published per epoch. A random dawn audit replays one past answer and demands live re-derivation under a new seed within 4 hours on a 32 GB node, checked against the hash. One honest agent re-derives 1 transcript for about $0.40; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 distinct transcripts on 10 separate machines, at 10 times the cost. Peers check the hash against public logs and slash the $500 bond of any agent whose re-derivation diverges, freezing repeat offenders next quartz epoch.
